user_query: I'm organizing a gaming event for my company and we want to showcase the latest updates in the Hearthstone game. Can you provide us with the current patch information and the available card backs? Moreover, we would like to include Diablo 4 gameplays in our event to engage the attendees. Thank you!

TaskList.description: Fetch the latest patch information for the Hearthstone game.
Retrieve the available card backs in the Hearthstone game.
Gather gameplay videos or streaming information for Diablo 4 to showcase at the event.
Compile and organize the patch information, card backs, and Diablo 4 gameplays for the event presentation.
